items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: San Francisco, US URL: https://redditinc.com/ Senior Product Adoption Strategist (Shopping) Remote - United States Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 116 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Location: NYC We’re assembling a collaborative team of individuals to drive Reddit Ads product adoption within our Global Sales organization and with advertisers. The Product Adoption team’s mission is to accelerate and scale the adoption of priority products and features to drive advertiser success and revenue growth. We are looking for our next team member who can help us to innovate and scale across our major adoption programs. In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Shopping product adoption across Large Customer Sales and Mid-Market advertisers worldwide. You will partner with Sales to pitch, onboard, activate, and grow advertisers on our Shopping product solutions and activate high-priority business opportunities. building global ads product adoption programs for advertisers and agencies. Your close partners will also include Product, PMM, Strategy & Ops, Enablement, and Marketing Science. You will drive the activation of our Shopping ads products to meet our customers' performance goals. You will work directly with account teams and advertisers to pitch, onboard, and activate across our Shopping solutions. Additionally, you will advocate for advertiser Shopping product needs, opportunities, and gaps within Reddit’s R&D organization. Why Join Reddit’s Product Adoption Team? Innovative Environment: Be part of a newly reimagined team at one of the most dynamic platforms worldwide, contributing to groundbreaking strategies that drive growth. Career Advancement: Significant opportunities for career development and mobility as you help shape the future of product adoption at Reddit. Collaborative Culture: Join a group of thoughtful, smart, and adaptable individuals who value collaboration and support each other's growth. Responsibilities: Drive Growth: Lead efforts to scale the adoption of Reddit’s Shopping ads products, increasing advertiser engagement and revenue. Develop Channel Strategies: Create and implement sales strategies tailored to Shopping ads programs in support of Large Customer Sales (LCS) and Mid-Market advertisers and sales teams worldwide. Engage Clients: Work directly with advertisers to identify, pitch, activate, onboard, and grow clients with strategic product opportunities. Enable Sales: Customize enablement for sales by channel and ensure that teams have the necessary knowledge, training, collateral, and market insights to effectively position and implement Reddit's Shopping ad products. Leverage Partners: Work with 3P partners to accelerate Shopping ads growth. Foster Feedback Loop: Advocate for advertiser needs and identify opportunities and gaps, providing feedback to PMM and Product teams to inform ongoing product development. Measure results: Partner with Sales and Strategy & Operations leadership to track progress to goal and identify steps that can be taken to accelerate outcomes. Basic Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, sales, marketing strategy, operations, or relevant industries Industry Experience: A strong background in product adoption, growth, or sales strategy within the digital advertising industry. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with partner teams, leveraging cross-functional expertise to drive program success. Proficient in Google Suite and Salesforce. Passion for understanding client needs and delivering solutions that drive their success. Preferred Qualifications: Direct Shopping product and/or eCommerce experience Analytical Skills: Solid familiarity with data analysis techniques and tools such as Mode, Tableau, and Salesforce to track key metrics and outcomes. Project Management: Excellent program and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives concurrently. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of clearly articulating strategies and outcomes to internal and external stakeholders. Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. items.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
items.summary: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote Opportunity Snapshot Pay: $30 - $60 per hour Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis , with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence (securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

Our mission is to help small and medium-sized US businesses grow and become more profitable by having access to highly engaged, skilled, and experienced talent at a fair price, and to generate career opportunities for bilingual professionals in Latin America with fair compensation and opportunities for professional and personal growth. We are currently looking for a Marketing Assistant to support marketing and communications efforts. This is a hands-on execution and ownership role for a seasoned marketing professional who can independently manage campaigns, create high-quality content, and help elevate brand presence across all channels. This is not an entry-level role - we are looking for someone who understands marketing strategy, executes at a high level, and brings ideas forward - not just deliverables. In Teamswell, every team member has an instrumental role and impact on the success of our business and our clients’ success, so we seek to have highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced work environment, who are intelligent, eager to work hard, reliable, and able to communicate effectively with all levels of an organization. Our Marketing Assistant will possess the skills and experience required, as well as a positive attitude and ability to solve complex problems and work in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. We value people who are good communicators, quick learners, scrappy about finding creative solutions to problems, and conscious of their work quality. We expect all our team members to deliver excellence in both technical expertise as well as in their everyday relationships with their team. RESPONSIBILITIES Execute marketing campaigns for chapter events, programs, and initiatives from concept through delivery Develop and manage content across social media and digital platforms Create newsletters, flyers, PDFs, and promotional materials that are polished, engaging, and on-brand Manage and grow social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn Design high-quality visual content using Canva or equivalent tools Maintain and update website content as needed (event pages, announcements, resources) Use CRM/marketing tools such as Pipedrive to support campaign execution and tracking Monitor engagement and performance metrics and provide insights and recommendations Ensure full brand consistency across all communications and platforms Requirements REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS Proven experience in digital marketing, content strategy, and campaign execution (not hobby-level or occasional freelance work) Strong portfolio of work across social media, email marketing, and digital campaigns Advanced design capability using Canva or similar tools (high-quality flyers, PDFs, and social creative) Hands-on experience managing brand accounts on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn Demonstrated ability to create and execute email newsletters and campaign content Experience with CRM or marketing automation tools (Pipedrive preferred, or equivalent such as HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, etc.) Comfort managing and updating website content (WordPress or similar platforms) Exceptional attention to detail and strong sense of brand consistency Excellent communication skills with a proactive, solution-oriented approach Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/teamswell-marketing-assistant

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote URL: https://growthminded.co About the role You'll own the data layer underneath InsightsOS and EngageOS, the products that turn booking, CRM, ad, and financial data from multi-location brands into proactive insights and automated actions. Build and maintain pipelines from sources like Mindbody, Zenoti, Boulevard, Mariana Tek, Domo, QuickBooks Online, GA4, Google Ads, Meta, and Klaviyo. Deep in SQL and Python, strong with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework, warehouse design (BigQuery, Postgres), and orchestration. items.description: Hunley is a rapidly growing Salesforce Summit Partner headquartered in Davidson, NC, with a fully remote team working from all corners of the country. We move quickly, collaborate deeply, and keep our clients at the center of everything we do. We’re proud to be known not just as a trusted partner to our clients, but also as a place where people genuinely enjoy working. We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Solution Architect to serve as the senior process, strategy, and architectural lead on client engagements. You’ll own the full arc of a project, from discovery and solution design through delivery, and will establish yourself as a trusted, long-term advisor to our clients. This is a senior, client-facing, billable role. You should be confident driving discovery and analysis with clients at all levels, constructing architecture strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams through delivery. You’ll also contribute to building and improving Hunley’s internal processes and delivery standards. About Hunley Hunley is a Salesforce Summit Partner and boutique implementation consultancy specializing in the construction, building products, and manufacturing industries. In 2026, Hunley joined forces with TrebleHook, a Salesforce OEM/ISV platform, to form CRM Solutions, a combined entity delivering both implementation services and proprietary product development. We’re at an exciting inflection point, expanding our capabilities in data, AI, and integration architecture, and actively building the team that will take us there. What You’ll Do Serve as the senior architectural and strategic lead on client projects, from discovery through go-live Lead business process design, solution architecture, and integration design in partnership with Technical Architects Take point with clients: drive discovery, construct proposals, present recommendations, and manage stakeholder relationships Develop deep understanding of each client’s business, maintaining trusted advisor status across engagements Contribute to scoping, estimation, and proposal development in partnership with sales and leadership Help develop and refine Hunley’s delivery processes, standards, and architectural best practices Mentor and guide consultants and junior architects on the team What We’re Looking For 5+ years of Salesforce implementation experience, with demonstrated expertise in solution architecture Strong, confident client presence: able to lead discovery, navigate ambiguity, and communicate clearly with business and technical stakeholders at all levels Experience designing end-to-end solutions including integrations, data architecture, and process strategy Salesforce certifications required; Architect track certifications strongly preferred Experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering & Construction), building products, or manufacturing industries is a significant plus Comfortable in a boutique consulting environment: you own your engagements, contribute to process-building, and thrive without a large support infrastructure Collaborative, curious, and invested in the growth of the team and the company Bonus Points Hands-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce, or AI-adjacent solutions Familiarity with integration platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato) Experience with TrebleHook or similar Salesforce OEM/ISV products Background building repeatable delivery frameworks or practice standards Why Hunley Fully remote: Work from anywhere in the US. Our team is spread coast to coast. Competitive compensation: Base + bonus structure; salary commensurate with experience Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer 401(k) match Equipment stipend: $1,000 one-time home office setup + company-provided laptop of your choice Internet stipend: $100/month, automatically paid via direct deposit FTO: Flexible time off. We trust you to manage your time. Culture: A tight-knit, high-trust team that cares about each other, not just outcomes Interested candidates should submit a resume and a brief note describing what drew you to this role and why you believe you’d be a strong fit. If you’re hungry to grow, eager to be challenged, and ready to work alongside a sharp, driven team at a fast-growing Salesforce Partner — we’d love to connect. At Hunley, we’re building more than just great client outcomes — we’re creating a workplace where diverse perspectives thrive, where every team member feels seen and supported, and where belonging is more than just a buzzword. We believe that diverse teams are stronger teams, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds and walks of life to apply. We offer competitive compensation and a solid benefits package — and we promise, you’ll never be bored. Note: This role is for direct applicants only. No recruiters or agencies, please.

items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, Texas | Lisbon, Portugal About The Department Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployed across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet. About The Role We need to make thoughtful infrastructure choices affecting a significant portion of the Internet. Hardware we work with includes GPUs, servers and components, as well as PDUs and network hardware. As a Hardware Systems Engineer, you will work with colleagues on the Engineering teams, Product and Performance teams, and Hardware Sourcing teams to design, qualify and maintain Cloudflare’s worldwide fleet of GPU servers. What You’ll Do Contribute to the technical requirements and end-to-end delivery of AI infrastructure — compute, networking, storage, power, and cooling — not just the accelerator Evaluate, select, and qualify AI hardware platforms (GPUs, custom ASICs, SmartNICs, storage) based on real workload requirements and first-principles analysis Design and validate rack-scale GPU systems: multi-node topologies, high-speed interconnects (NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCE), power distribution, and thermal management Run hands-on qualification: benchmarking, stress testing, failure mode analysis, and vendor RCA — you close the loop yourself Assess and qualify ODM/OEM server platforms; engage directly with vendors and work through the full technical qualification cycle Translate AI product and workload requirements into precise infrastructure specifications Identify gaps in the existing infrastructure stack and drive solutions across hardware, firmware, software, and operations Stay ahead of the AI hardware landscape — new silicon, new interconnects, new form factors — and bring informed, opinionated recommendations Build tooling and automation to support qualification workflows, performance analysis, and ongoing operational visibility Communicate your results and updates through blog posts and internal talks Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science Experience in AI infrastructure, systems engineering, or hardware platform engineering First-principles understanding of AI accelerator architecture: compute pipelines, memory hierarchy (HBM, GDDR), interconnect topology, and/or how workload characteristics map to hardware capabilities Hands-on experience qualifying AI server platforms — you’ve run NCCL tests, profiled collective operations, debugged NVLink errors, and chased down PCIe lane misconfigurations Understand rack-scale systems: high-density power (kW/rack, busbar, PDU), liquid cooling (rear-door, direct liquid, immersion), high-speed networking infrastructure, and/or physical layer constraints Experience with AI/ML frameworks (vllm, sglang) at the systems level — you understand what they demand from the hardware and where bottlenecks actually live Familiarity with AI server form factors: HGX, OAC, OAM, UBB, open rack standards, and the tradeoffs between them Scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, Go and Linux sysadmin); you build tooling to support your own work and the team’s Strong written communication — you can write a rigorous technical specification and a crisp vendor requirements document Knowledge of performance benchmarking ; Previous experience in testing, measuring, and/or simulating hardware performance and an understanding of no-stone-left-unturned experimentation Knowledge of Redfish, IPMI and server remote management protocols, and experience with firmware updates Harness AI tools and automation to fundamentally accelerate the qualification lifecycle, driving exponential efficiency gains and quality standards. Possess the organizational skills and interest to manage cross-functional technical projects, ensuring architectural designs seamlessly align with delivery schedules. Thrive as a deeply self-motivated engineer in ambiguous environments, demonstrating a strong bias for action and the ability to drive initiatives forward without close supervision. Bonus Points Experience with major AI server ODMs/OEMs and their qualification and customization processes Exposure to hyperscaler or cloud infrastructure design — understanding how GPU capacity is provisioned, allocated, and operated at scale Experience with RDMA networking, RoCEv2 congestion control, or InfiniBand fabric management Understanding of AI workload patterns: LLM training vs. inference, model/tensor/pipeline parallelism, and their memory and bandwidth implications Familiarity with open compute hardware programs or OCP specifications Experience of performance optimization based on hardware / software codesign Experience of kernel development, compiler optimization, or driver development. Experience of observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, as well as the ability to observe trends over time Experience with software development tools and processes such as Git, TeamCity and Jira Experience in a hyperscale cloud infrastructure role also valuable Knowledge of debugging server hardware faults and the ability to engage with our sourcing team and vendors to improve quality Who You Are A self-starter who identifies what needs to be done and executes without waiting to be asked Genuinely curious — you read architecture whitepapers, follow chip announcements, and have opinions on why one memory subsystem beats another Equally comfortable racking servers in a lab and writing a detailed technical requirements document Able to make a defensible technical decision with incomplete information, and communicate the reasoning clearly Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €54,000-68,000 Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S. Health & Welfare Benefits Medical/Rx Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts Commuter Spending Accounts Fertility & Family Forming Benefits On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program Global Travel Medical Insurance Financial Benefits Short and Long Term Disability Insurance Life & Accident Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Employee Stock Participation Plan Time Off Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actualrace, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

items.description: Are you an experienced geospatial professional eager to shape the future of AI? We’re developing a geospatial reasoning agent focused on Crisis Response—helping AI systems understand, assess, and predict real-world events where data is uncertain or incomplete. Your expertise will guide model development and evaluation, laying the foundation for future geospatial reasoning and forecasting applications. We’re looking for experts with deep experience in geospatial analysis, crisis response, or related domains such as damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, supply chain optimization, or forecasting. You’ll evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify analytical weaknesses, and design metrics and test cases that advance model understanding and predictive accuracy. On a typical day, you’ll review geospatial scenarios, validate model outputs, define and refine reasoning frameworks, and collaborate with our team to improve data-driven evaluations. Ideal candidates bring professional experience in geospatial analysis, GIS systems, or spatial modeling within industries such as crisis management, logistics, or environmental planning. Proficiency with geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, PostGIS) is preferred. Strong reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex spatial relationships clearly are essential. Ready to apply your geospatial expertise to the frontier of AI? Apply today and help design intelligent systems capable of supporting real-time global decision-making. We offer a pay range of $24 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions. You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience. The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas. This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots. Key Responsibilities Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning. Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency. Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities. Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain. Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact. Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates. Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels. Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy. Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance. Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities. SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences. Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code. Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time. Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently. This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations. Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote - USA About the Role Cybercrime doesn't wait for anyone to catch up to it, and neither do we. Abnormal AI is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our SLED team, selling behavioral AI security solutions into large, complex State, Local, and Education agencies within a defined territory. We didn't bolt AI onto old security tools. We built our platform from AI up, to catch the human-targeted attacks that legacy tools miss, and public sector organizations need that protection as much as anyone. The ideal candidate is local to the Sacramento area and brings experience selling cybersecurity solutions into large public sector environments , particularly Enterprise-level SLED organizations, along with: Proven hunter focused on selling to large state and local government agencies, with a disciplined approach to early pipeline development and prospecting. Skilled at leveraging all five demand generation pillars: AE prospecting, SDRs, marketing, channel partnerships, and customer referrals. Strong qualifier with the ability to uncover public sector pain points and map them to compelling, value-driven solutions. Effective presenter who tailors demos and messaging to resonate with government stakeholders and address their specific challenges. Process-oriented with a consistent sales methodology and strong time management skills to manage multiple deals efficiently. Data-disciplined, maintaining accurate and up-to-date account and opportunity data across systems. Experienced in building business cases that quantify ROI and value for diverse public sector audiences, including IT, procurement, and leadership. Knowledge sharer who captures and organizes customer insights and lessons learned to support team learning. Skilled at guiding public sector customers through complex internal buying processes, including procurement and RFP cycles. Resilient and resourceful, with a strong track record of success in early-stage environments. Effective at leveraging internal teams such as Sales Engineering, Marketing, BDRs, Product, and Customer Success to drive results in the SLED space. What You Will Do Sell Abnormal AI solutions to large Enterprise SLED agencies with a mandate to overachieve new annual recurring revenue quota, not just hit it. Run the full deal cycle in your accounts: first conversation, technical evaluation, contract signature, and the upsell conversations that follow once they're a customer. Prospect and build new business opportunities to keep your pipeline ahead of target. Sell a platform that's actively expanding underneath you: what started as email security now covers identity, AI security, and insider threat, giving you more surface area to bring value to every agency. Partner with Customer Success to protect timely renewals and surface expansion opportunities. Keep your data sharp across Salesforce, Highspot, and Close Plan, because accurate pipeline is how the whole team plans and wins. Be the customer's advocate inside Abnormal, working with Sales Engineering, Product, and Marketing to get the right things prioritized so more revenue closes, faster. Must Haves Enterprise SLED Account Hunter: 8+ years of direct (not overlay) enterprise sales experience prospecting and closing large, complex SLED accounts. A proven track record of both closing new account logos and growing existing accounts through cross-sell and upsell within the State of California. Negotiation skill that holds up against large organizations and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. A track record to back it up: consistent over-quota performance, ideally top 5% of your sales org. Technical fluency across security, email, cloud, and AI, enough to hold your own in a conversation with a security or IT leader. Cybersecurity or security-adjacent SaaS sales experience, selling subscription software to CISOs and security personnel. A builder's mindset: you've thrived somewhere early-stage, an underdog, or up against bigger incumbents, and you know how to build territory with limited resources. Comfort selling within a company that's still writing its next chapter. We're growing 40%+ year over year, protecting more than 4,500 customers including over 25% of the Fortune 500, and expanding fast from email into identity, AI security, and insider threat. That means more to sell, more to learn, and more room to make your mark than a mature market leader can offer. #LI-LB2 Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . This will include site selection, feasibility, budgeting, design team & contractor selection, project management, build-out, and regulatory re
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://gilbertpharmaceuticals.com/ The Head of Design, Development, & Construction will own the entire end to end process of launching new compounding pharmacies nationally. This will include site selection, feasibility, budgeting, design team & contractor selection, project management, build-out, and regulatory readiness of all Gilbert Pharmaceuticals pharmacy facilities. Reporting to the Director of Pharmacy Development & Operations, this role bridges pharmacy operations expertise with construction, facilities engineering, and regulatory compliance to bring new pharmacy sites from concept through licensure and go-live. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience designing and building efficient commercial spaces and pharmacy environments including traditional 503A compounding pharmacies and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities operating under current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) Standards. Their thorough knowledge enables them to successfully navigate state and federal regulations required for pharmacy facility approval. At Gilbert Pharmaceuticals , every role is AI-first. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into the right tools to explore and execute, is tested with real users and stakeholders, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of how we work, not side experiments. We are looking for people who take full ownership of their work, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building a company that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered. We're Looking For You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You have care for performance, accessibility, and reliability as part of craft. You are passionate and proficient in written and verbal communication, and comfort pairing with designers, engineers, and marketers. Key Responsibilities Acquisition Lead market analysis and site selection to identify viable pharmacy locations nationally. Conduct feasibility assessments and due diligence on prospective sites, evaluating regulatory feasibility, build-out complexity, and operational suitability. Develop and execute entitlement strategy for new pharmacy locations in coordination with legal and operations teams. Act as liaison between landlords, brokers, and Gilbert Pharmaceuticals on your prospective sites. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to supply landlords and brokers with essential company information to secure new leases and site acquisitions. Entitlements Navigate land use and zoning requirements for each new pharmacy site. Lead master plan coordination and manage environmental compliance obligations across all facility projects. Oversee community outreach efforts and represent Gilbert Pharmaceuticals at public hearings as needed. Coordinate regulatory submissions and interface directly with operations team on state Boards of Pharmacy, DEA, FDA, and local authorities for facility inspections and approvals. Develop and maintain a facility compliance playbook for new site design and existing facility modifications. Design Lead concept and programming strategy for all new pharmacy facilities, translating operational workflows into effective, compliant physical environments. Manage design team selection and coordination, including architects, MEP engineers, and specialty consultants. Lead the architectural design and space planning for new pharmacy locations, including compounding suites, sterile and non-sterile areas, clean rooms, and dispensing environments. Develop detailed facility design standards and specifications aligned with USP <795>, USP <797>, USP <800>, applicable state Board of Pharmacy requirements, and FDA cGMP requirements for 503B outsourcing facilities. Review and approve architectural drawings, construction documents, and engineering plans for all new pharmacy projects. Design scalable production environments for 503A and 503B operations, including batch manufacturing areas, quarantine/release zones, and controlled material flow segregation. Develop HVAC, cleanroom, airflow, and environmental monitoring specifications in coordination with engineering and operating partners. Coordinate with operating partners to ensure facility design supports validated processes, environmental monitoring programs, and batch production controls. Pre-Con Develop project budgets and oversee value engineering exercises to optimize cost without compromising regulatory or operational standards. Lead GC selection processes, evaluating contractors for pharmacy build-out experience, compliance track record, and execution capability. Manage permit management across all active projects, ensuring timely approvals from local building authorities and regulatory bodies. Develop and track project timelines, procurement schedules, and risk mitigation plans across multiple concurrent site developments. Construction Serve as Owner's representative throughout construction, maintaining accountability for design intent, budget, and schedule. Provide field oversight through regular site inspections and quality walkthroughs to ensure regulatory and operational standards are met. Maintain rigorous cost control across all active build-outs, managing change orders and contractor performance. Oversee FF&E installation and commissioning of all pharmacy-specific equipment and systems. Manage QA & closeout activities including installation qualifications of critical manufacturing utilities (e.g., WFI systems, clean steam, environmental monitoring) where applicable to 503A and 503B facilities. Drive operational readiness in partnership with pharmacy operations and quality teams, ensuring facilities are inspection-ready as soon as possible. Maintain up-to-date documentation including as-built drawings, equipment lists, and SOPs for all facility environments. Support evaluation of pharmacy partners by assessing the design and regulatory readiness of their existing facilities. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, or Chemical), Pharmacy, or a closely related field; advanced degree or licensure preferred. 5+ years of experience designing, building, or commissioning pharmacy facilities, healthcare environments, or regulated laboratory/cleanroom spaces. Ability to understand/learn USP <795>, USP <797>, USP <800>, and applicable state Board of Pharmacy facility requirements. Demonstrated project management experience overseeing construction projects from design through commissioning. Experience interfacing with regulatory agencies on facility approvals and inspections. Proficiency with architectural drawings, construction documents, and facility engineering specifications. Experience designing or supporting sterile manufacturing or 503B outsourcing facilities operating under cGMP environments strongly preferred. Ability to travel to pharmacy sites as needed for construction oversight, inspections, and go-live support. Preferred Licensed Architect (AIA), Professional Engineer (PE), or Certified Pharmaceutical Industry Professional (CPIP). Familiarity with digital health or telehealth-linked pharmacy models. Strong vendor management experience working with contractors, engineers, and equipment suppliers. What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months) Documented pharmacy facility design standards and a reusable build-out playbook for new sites. Streamlined project flow to maximize efficiency and completion time per project. Documented budgets for all existing and prospective sites with cost efficient suggestions to scale nationally. Successful delivery of at least three to five new 503A pharmacy facilities on time, on budget, and licensed for operation. Successful delivery of at least one 503B pharmacy facility on time, on budget, and licensed for operation. All existing partner facilities assessed and documented against Gilbert's compliance standards. Strong cross-functional relationships established with pharmacy operations, contracting, and external vendor teams. Benefits Base salary, equity, and bonus structure are open to discussion based on experience and fit. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gilbert-pharmaceuticals-head-of-design-development-construction

We’re seeking a Brand Strategy Director to partner with marketing leadership on long-term brand strategy, positioning, and messaging. About the Role Hourly Rate: $90/hour Contract Duration: 3 months, starting ASAP with potential to convert to FTE Location: Fully remote Weekly Hours: 40 Company Description We’re a leading shopping rewards platform focused on building credibility, desire, and loyalty with our members, engaging our current customer base, and driving new member acquisition. As we continue to grow and evolve our brand and product roadmap, we’re bringing on an experienced brand strategist to help define what sets us apart and keep our positioning cohesive across the business. Job Description As our Brand Strategy Director, you’ll partner closely with our VP of Brand and Creative to shape the long-term brand strategy that drives growth, awareness, and loyalty. You’ll craft positioning that differentiates our products and services, inform partnerships and new platforms, and make sure our brand story stays consistent across teams and initiatives. Consumer research will play a supporting role, grounding your strategy in a clear understanding of who our members are and what they need. Scope of Support Brand Strategy and Positioning Partner with the VP of Brand and Creative to develop long-term brand strategy focused on growth, awareness, and loyalty Craft brand strategy that differentiates our products and services and tells a compelling story in a competitive landscape Inform brand direction for partnerships and new platforms Drive cohesion of brand positioning across initiatives, partnerships, and cross-functional teams Consumer Understanding Translate consumer research into insights that serve as the foundation for positioning and messaging Identify high-value audience segments and help size the opportunity Stay on top of consumer, marketplace, and competitive trends and bring them back to the team Cross-Functional Partnership and Measurement Collaborate with marketing, business, and product stakeholders to identify key strategic questions Support brand campaign measurement through brand studies, working with agency partners to share learnings across the organization Qualifications 12+ years of experience driving strategic brand work in a management consultancy, agency, or the brand organization of a well-loved consumer brand A strong point of view on what makes a brand distinctive and salient Ability to quickly grasp complex business models, product roadmaps, and shifting market dynamics Experience using qualitative and quantitative research to inform strategic recommendations Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, particularly in customer segmentation Excellent communicator who can make complex concepts clear for different audiences Proven cross-functional relationship builder who thrives in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities This is a W2 role. Additional Information We Are Rosie provides strategic consulting and talent solutions for the marketing industry. We partner with more than 200 of the world’s biggest brands and agencies to help them solve unique marketing challenges with the best people, swiftly and at scale. Founded by former advertising executive Stephanie Nadi Olson in 2018, We Are Rosie is on a mission to redefine how marketing works, with an inclusive, human-centric approach that’s better for business and better for marketers. Our company has been recognized as an industry trailblazer and earned many accolades, including being named to the 2023 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces, the Inc. 5000 2022, and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Agencies in 2021. items.description: Why You’ll Love This Role: Field Sales Specialists (Per Diem) will provide critical on-the-ground operational, logistical, and promotional support for Newsela’s California Core Adoption campaign. Working on an as-needed basis, these specialists serve as high-impact brand ambassadors who partner directly with Sales Consultants to execute local ground campaigns, manage sample and material drop-offs, staff regional conferences (e.g., CABE, CISC, CALSA), and support district pilot setups. Examples of ideal candidates would be former educators, retired K-12 administrators, curriculum TOSAs, or experienced EdTech field contractors. Location: Northern CA + Central Valley, Southern CA, Greater Los Angeles What You’ll Be Doing: Direct District & COE Drop-offs: Deliver print samples, pilot materials, and promotional collateral directly to County Offices of Education and school districts across assigned geographic areas. School Site Engagement: Conduct drop-ins at middle and high school campuses to deliver core ELA preview materials and event invitations to department heads, ELA TOSAs, and principals Conference Setup & Tear-Down: Assist with the physical setup, arrangement of display materials, and tear-down of Newsela exhibition booths at statewide and regional conferences. Booth Representation: When needed, provide additional manpower at conference booths to engage attendees, capture lead information; and introduce Threads & Themes. Pilot Logistics: Support the delivery and distribution of pilot classroom materials, teacher guide packages, and student login collateral for active district pilot programs. About You: 2+ years of experience in K-12 education, educational sales support, conference event staffing, or field marketing within the EdTech/publishing industry. (Prior classroom teaching or curriculum experience in California is highly preferred). Familiarity with the California public school system, County Offices of Education (COEs), and basic ELA/ELD instructional terminology. Valid California Driver’s License, reliable personal vehicle, and proof of auto insurance (travel reimbursement provided). Ability to lift and transport boxes of print materials/booth equipment weighing up to 35–40 lbs. Availability to work flexible hours, including early mornings for drop-offs or full days during multi-day educational conferences. No overnight travel. Legally authorized to work in the US. All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check as part of our pre-employment process. Why you’ll love working at Newsela: Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical benefits with employer contribution to premiums and to HSA accounts. Additional benefits such as gym reimbursement, pet insurance, free access to the Calm app, Rocket Lawyer and more to help you stay healthy: mind, body, and soul. Work From Home: We are a fully remote company. We provide a monthly tech stipend to support your WFH needs! Supporting ALL Families: Inclusive benefits to support you and your family, including parental leave, fertility support, adoption, and more! Financial Wellbeing: Invest in your future with our 401(k) plan, which includes a employer match to help you build long-term financial security. Time Off: Flexible PTO, paid sick time off, company holidays plus winter break (Dec 24th - Jan 1st). Professional Development: Newsela offers an annual learning and development allowance to employees to attend external training sessions, classes, workshops, conferences, and educational materials to foster professional growth within their current role and career aspirations at Newsela. Make A Difference: No matter your role or department, the work you do each day helps share the future of education and improves the lives of students and teachers. About Newsela: Newsela is a leading education technology company dedicated to meaningful classroom learning for every student. We deliver integrated, AI-powered solutions designed to unlock student engagement, empower teachers, and drive meaningful learning outcomes. Our suite of products supports knowledge and skill development, writing practice, daily instruction, assessment, and data-informed decision-making across K–12 classrooms. Grounded in learning science research, Newsela’s solutions integrate content, assessment, and analytics to help educators track progress, understand student outcomes, and deliver high-impact instruction that supports every learner. #LI-Remote Compensation: Hours/Week: Less than 30 hours / week during peak intervals Compensation: $25 - $30 / hour (or comparable industry standard) + mileage Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, and experience. Total compensation for this role also includes benefits. Base Compensation Range $25—$30 USD

items.title: Technical Customer Support
items.summary: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Who You Are You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom. Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A Plus If You Have Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps. Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How We Work Together You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer. Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask. Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked. The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.
