items.summary: About the role The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company. About Arabian Private Holdings Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets. What you will do Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment. Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations. Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies. Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals. Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates. Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized. Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews. Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports. What we are looking for A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving. Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors. Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English. Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors. Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review. A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics. How we work We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients. What the role offers A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market. Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates. Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region. The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote. Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.summary: Role Title: Federal Budget Analyst Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Federal Budget Analysts to contribute to a customer's project focused on budget formulation and execution within the federal sector.
items.description: Role Title: Federal Budget Analyst Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Federal Budget Analysts to contribute to a customer's project focused on budget formulation and execution within the federal sector. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. Scope of Work Create realistic training examples of federal budget justification materials, including narratives, exhibits, and supporting analyses. Write sample responses to OMB passback with clear, well-supported analysis, and annotate the reasoning behind each choice. Document mid-year reprogramming scenarios, noting which actions require higher-level approval and how they stay consistent with spend plans. Build worked examples that compare actual expenditures against planned obligations, evaluate fund availability, and explain variances. Walk through year-end closeout step by step, including reconciliation with accounting records and resolution of discrepancies. Write guidance on funding types, budget changes, and compliance requirements, drawing on how experienced analysts advise program managers. Produce templates, process walkthroughs, and annotated examples that capture how federal budget work is actually done. Review AI-generated budget content for accuracy, realism, and compliance, and explain what is wrong or missing so it can be corrected. Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of federal budget experience at about the GS-11/12 level or higher, in GS-0560, 0501, 0510, or comparable roles. Experience with budget formulation, execution, and funds control. Experience with OMB submissions, reprogramming, and year-end closeout. Familiarity with federal accounting and budget execution systems. Financial management certification (DoD FM, CGFM, or similar) a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Project OverviewWe are sourcing independent Audio Evaluation Specialists for an AI benchmark evaluation project assessing advanced agentic audio models.
items.description: Project Overview We are sourcing independent Audio Evaluation Specialists for an AI benchmark evaluation project assessing advanced agentic audio models. As AI models increasingly handle complex workflows in this domain—specifically real-world customer support scenarios like flight bookings, financial services, and telecommunications—their accuracy relies entirely on robust, expert-crafted training data. The objective of this project is to autonomously produce high-quality evaluation tasks through simulated interactions, audit conversational AI outputs, and generate clean, reliable datasets to optimize model performance. Project Deliverables & Scope Operate autonomously to design complex evaluation frameworks and provide structured training data. Expected deliverables include: Role-Play Scenario Execution: Creating and executing complex, role-play-based evaluation scenarios that simulate realistic customer service interactions across travel, finance, and technical support domains. Model Performance Auditing: Evaluating AI model performance across standardized qualitative and quantitative metrics, focusing strictly on task completion accuracy, conversational naturalness, and audio comprehension. Technical Metric Evaluation: Assessing the model's basic computer programming literacy, including its understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and ability to reason about structured data within a support context. Representative Dataset Generation: Contributing to the development of diverse, high-quality audio datasets that accurately reflect real customer expectations for clarity, efficiency, and natural conversational flow. Required Expertise To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess deep industry knowledge to craft realistic professional scenarios. Core skillset includes: Demonstrable professional expertise in complex customer support, technical troubleshooting, or conversational AI evaluation. Native or bilingual proficiency in the target language, including fluency across all language skills (reading, listening, writing, and speaking), alongside strong analytical and verbal communication skills to confidently conduct simulated customer support role-plays. Basic computer programming literacy, specifically a comfortable understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and simple logic. A meticulous, detail-oriented approach to working with structured prompts, complex evaluation rubrics, and technical guidelines. Required Equipment: Access to a high-quality microphone to ensure clean, reliable audio input during voice evaluations. We offer a pay range of $6-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor Workplace Type: Remote Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Role Title: Materials Scientist (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release) Role Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is engaging Materials Scientists (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release) to contribute specialized expertise to a customer’s project focused on advanced nanomaterial evaluation.
items.description: Role Title: Materials Scientist (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Materials Scientists (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release) to contribute specialized expertise to a customer’s project focused on advanced nanomaterial evaluation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. ABOUT THE COMPANY: Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY At Salesloft, our Business Systems Administrator, Customer Experience is critical to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Business Systems team and will lead generating, scoping, solutioning, and executing process and efficiency improvement efforts across customer-focused systems. You will have a passionate, capable team supporting you. You will be responsible for the support, development, and maintenance of Salesforce and its related Customer Experience systems. You must own the pursuit of a world-class technology experience for our customers, while enabling scale and efficiency for internal customer experience teams - Support, Services, and Success. You need to have pride in the work you do and a passion for customer support and success. On a day to day basis, you will: Work with Services, Success, and Support teams to identify manual process that can be automated Scope, Plan, Recommend, and Deliver system solutions that help these teams meet their Objectives and Key Results Play a leading role in the exploration, design, build, delivery, and support of a redesigned and improved Customer Hub This role lives at the heart of how we Make Your Mark: you'll treat systems administration as a discipline — automating, documenting, and fixing root causes so the same issues don't recur. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll administer access and configuration as the security controls they are, protecting the company and the data customers trust us with. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are seeking a Salesforce CRM, and related customer experience systems, expert. Someone that can see the big picture, future state but has a keen eye for details. You will have a knack for spotting opportunities to improve systems and process, and are excited to work cross-functionally to make it happen. You are passionate to build relationships to help others succeed. If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Business Systems Administrator is the career path for you! THE TEAM Our Salesloft’s Revenue Operations team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming operational experts. Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired. The Revenue Operations team consists of team members that work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Services, Finance, and IT to create systems to more efficiently prospect, forecast, close, onboard, and support customers. Team members conceptualize the strategic priorities for the company, develop execution plans, execute plans cross-functionally, and operationalize executed strategies for continuous improvement. THE SKILL SET Bachelor's degree 3+ years experience in a related role, Software (SaaS) experience is a plus 2-3 years experience administering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Knowledge, Live Agent, and Customer Communities preferred Salesforce Administrator certification is required Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant certification is a plus Demonstrated experience designing, revising and managing Salesforce Flows Ability to lead teams through change management and business transformations Excellent project management skills and the ability to collaborate with management and others in the company Disciplined, flexible, and autonomous work habits; we don't micromanage Understanding of the SaaS business model and culture is a plus At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us! items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Chicago | Salt Lake City | Remote (US) Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll play a key role in driving new business growth by acquiring net-new customers for Gong Foundations. You will own and manage the full sales cycle, with 100% focus on outbound prospecting. RESPONSIBILITIES Source and manage a pipeline of net-new prospects through proactive outbound prospecting, from lead to close focused on Gong Foundations. Clearly articulate and demonstrate our value proposition, creating excitement and enthusiasm among prospects. Build relationships with net-new logos to drive them through the sales cycle to close Maintain weekly sales forecast and achieve new business quota quarterly. Run and implement 7 to 10 day pilot program. QUALIFICATIONS Located in the Lehi area within a commutable distance to our office, with the ability to work our hybrid schedule of 3 days/week in-office. 6 months+ of relevant new business/net-new logo closing experience for Commercial. Previous SaaS and enterprise software experience preferred. Strong previous outbound prospecting experience — you're comfortable building your own pipeline, not just working inbound leads. Demonstrated success in achieving new business sales goals (President's Club, Rep of the Year, etc.) Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Comfortable selling to VP and C-Suite executives, navigating multiple decision makers within an organization — experience selling to sales leaders specifically is a plus. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets. We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect. As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll work with a portfolio of SMB and Mid-Market customers across a wide range of verticals and industries. That means the best outcomes rarely come from running a standard playbook. We need someone who finds that energizing, someone curious enough to understand how a complex organization actually operates, disciplined enough to orchestrate complex,multi-threaded sales cycles, and resourceful enough to bring the right people in at the right moment. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning an initial opportunity into a strategic relationship, navigating increasingly complex deals, and finding new ways for Airtable to create value across an organization, you’ll thrive here. We hire Corporate AEs with growth in mind: you’ll get the exposure, coaching, and increasing deal complexity you need to ramp quickly toward becoming an Enterprise Account Executive. What you'll do Turn Airtable’s large self-service user base into new business, using existing adoption and proven use cases to uncover and develop high-potential opportunities. Build relationships with leaders across functions and industries, understanding what matters to them and finding opportunities to expand Airtable’s impact as their organizations grow. Own and prioritize your book of business, developing thoughtful account plans and finding your way from an initial champion to stakeholders across the organization. Lead complex sales cycles from first conversation through close, bringing in Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and other partners at the right moments to move opportunities forward. Become a trusted advisor to prospects: understand their business objectives and bring Airtable’s flexibility to life through compelling use cases that show how the platform can solve their problems and transform the way their teams work. Who you are You bring 1-3 years of quota-carrying closing experience at a technology company You’ve successfully closed deals with mid-market and larger organizations (50-3,000 FTEs), with a track record of hitting or exceeding your sales goals. You can run a structured sales process (e.g., Force Management) with rigor and self-awareness. You know where your deals stand, what needs to happen next, and which stakeholders to bring in at the right moments to move them forward. You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder. You build credibility with business leaders and executives, develop the trust needed to move opportunities forward, and create alignment across g stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle. You’re an adaptable seller. You’re comfortable moving across industries, use cases, and buyer personas, and you know how to make your approach relevant to each. What we offer Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills and experience. The on-target earnings range for this role is $182,800 to $238,100 for all office and remote locations. Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits and may include incentive compensation. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out Life at Airtable . Airtable is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any characteristic protected by applicable federal and state laws, regulations and ordinances. Airtable is committed to participating in the interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants. Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Airtable’s collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here . For applicants that live in or have a link to Australia, please see this Privacy Collection Statement for details regarding Airtable's collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process. Stay Safe from Job Scams: All official Airtable communication will come from an @airtable.com email address. We will never ask you to share sensitive information or purchase equipment during the hiring process. If in doubt, contact us at hr@airtable.com . Learn more about avoiding job scams here . items.description: A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation! More about our team and company: Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers About the Team The Strategic Response Management (SRM) function sits inside Solutions Consulting and partners with Sales to win the RFIs, RFPs, security questionnaires, and vendor assessments that stand between Fleetio and our largest deals. In the first twelve months since launch, SRM has helped drive a step change in RFx win rate, scale response support into enterprise-tier deals (think multi-million-dollar opportunities), and build a repeatable workflow powered by a custom internal AI agent grounded in Fleetio’s own documentation. We treat formal responses as a revenue lever, not an administrative task. About the Role As an Associate Proposals Consultant, you will own the day-to-day drafting and coordination work for a growing book of RFx responses, working alongside the Proposals Consultant on the function’s most strategic opportunities. You will write evaluator-ready answers, coordinate input from subject matter experts across Product, Security, Legal, and Customer Success, and help maintain the response library and workflow that makes the function scale. This is a strong fit for someone with two to three years of proposal management or writing experience who wants to grow within a function that is still being shaped and is directly tied to measurable revenue outcomes. What You Will Do Leverage AI tools to draft, edit, and submit RFI, RFP, and security questionnaire responses for commercial and public sector opportunities, following APMP-aligned best practices (Theme, Proof, Benefit). Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers from intake through submission to shape evaluator-facing messaging, identify discriminators, and keep responses on time. Coordinate with cross-functional subject matter experts in Product, Security, Legal, and Customer Success to validate technical, compliance, and contractual answers. Use Fleetio’s internal response AI tools to generate first-pass answers grounded in approved source material, then edit for voice, clarity, and win themes. Track response outcomes (progression, win rate, closed-won ARR influenced) and surface trends that help the function and Sales leadership improve pursuit decisions. Contribute to continuous improvement of the SRM workflow, intake process, and tooling, including battle card integration, competitive framing, and documentation. Represent SRM in internal reviews, pursuit syncs, and enablement sessions with Sales. What You Bring At least two years of hands-on experience managing or drafting RFx responses (RFIs, RFPs, security questionnaires, or vendor assessments) for commercial or public sector clients. Strong business writing skills: plain English, active voice, specific over generic, with the ability to turn technical input into evaluator-friendly answers. Experience coordinating input from cross-functional contributors under deadline pressure, managing multiple concurrent responses without dropping balls. A detail-first mindset: you catch question numbering, column mapping, submission formatting, and compliance requirements before submittal. Comfort working in a remote, collaborative environment with asynchronous communication, including Slack, Google Workspace, and shared documentation platforms. Nice to Have Experience responding to RFx opportunities on behalf of a software or SaaS company, including familiarity with security questionnaires such as CAIQ, SIG, or SOC 2 artifacts. APMP certification at the Foundation, Practitioner, or Professional level. Working knowledge of public sector procurement workflows, cooperative contracts, and state and local government RFP formats. Familiarity with fleet management, telematics, maintenance software, or an adjacent operational B2B software category. Comfort with AI-assisted drafting tools and prompt-based content generation. What Success Looks Like 30 days: Shipped the first set of responses end-to-end with coaching, learned the SRM intake and submission workflow, and met the core cross-functional partners. 60 days: Independently owning smaller RFIs and security questionnaires, contributing to library updates, and partnering directly with AEs on live deals. 90 days: Leading mid-sized RFPs end-to-end, measurably contributing to the function’s win rate and progression rate, and proposing at least one workflow or content improvement. Why Fleetio, Why Now The SRM function is young enough that your fingerprints will be on the standards, the library, and the tooling, and mature enough that your work ties directly to tracked monthly revenue outcomes. If you want to grow inside a function where great response writing is treated as a competitive weapon, this is the seat. Benefits Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family) Vision insurance Incentive stock options 401(k) match of 4% PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!) 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid) FSA & HSA options Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid) Community service funds Professional development funds Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only) Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will. If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.

Their teams bring together strategy, analytics, creative, media, e-commerce, and trade marketing, and they work with some of the best-known brands around. Job Description Start date: ASAP Length: About 8 weeks, depending on the final start date Hours: Up to 30 hours per week Location: Remote, working EST or CST hours Rate: $60/hr Engagement: W2 contract Job Description Our client needs a Digital Producer to keep paid media campaigns moving through the holiday push. You’ll support 12 footwear brands, each running 2 to 5 campaigns, and work with two client contacts. Your job is to make sure the right assets arrive on time and the team knows what’s approved, what’s late, and what can launch. What you’ll do: Monitor three weekly email chains, one for each brand unit, where the team requests assets and preview links Track approvals in the media workbook and flag when dates change so the team knows when a campaign can launch Check specs, review assets, and make sure everything needed is in hand Organize assets in Google Drive (no uploading to ad platforms) Follow up when something is behind or missing and flag it to the team Join internal team calls Qualifications Paid media experience across digital and social, including how campaigns are structured, timed, and communicated Familiarity with Facebook and Google Ads Asana experience strongly preferred 4+ years in digital production, project management, or traffic at a media or marketing agency Detail oriented, and comfortable following up with people who owe you something Available during EST hours, 4 or 5 days a week Additional Information We Are Rosie provides strategic consulting and talent solutions for the marketing industry. We partner with more than 200 of the world’s biggest brands and agencies to help them solve unique marketing challenges with the best people, swiftly and at scale. Founded by former advertising executive Stephanie Nadi Olson in 2018, We Are Rosie is on a mission to redefine how marketing works, with an inclusive, human-centric approach that’s better for business and better for marketers. Our company has been recognized as an industry trailblazer and earned many accolades, including being named to the 2023 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces, the Inc. 5000 2022, and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Agencies in 2021. items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: ignitionit.com URL: https://ignitionit.com Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first TL;DR ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role. We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you. What the actual job??? Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.” You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there. In a typical week, you might: Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless. Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with. Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing. Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone. Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline." ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job. About ignitionit.com We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile! What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way. We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here. If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance. The tech you'll work with (and grow into) Day one, you'll be living in: Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more) Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends) Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open. Who we hope you are The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you: Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both) Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem Have at least 5 years of IT support experience on the job. ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who: Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine) Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application) Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously Regarding AI Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive. Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you. Compensation & logistics Base salary: Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones. Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet. How to apply The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how: Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works. If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items. From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment. If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different? Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-msp-mac-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: USA - Remote About Ping Identity: At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. Position Summary As the Director of Partner Operations, you will lead the operational engine that powers our global partner ecosystem. You will be responsible for building and optimizing processes, tools, and programs that support all partner types—resell, referral, delivery, technology, MSP, and cloud marketplaces. You will collaborate closely with Sales Operations, Channel Sales, Alliances, Product, Finance, and Marketing to ensure our partner strategy is supported by scalable infrastructure and clear performance metrics. Please note: while this is a remote role, we are seeking candidates based in the Pacific or Mountain time zones to support close collaboration with our West Coast channel leadership. Key Responsibilities Partner Operations Strategy Lead the development and execution of partner operations strategy aligned to business growth goals. Design and implement scalable processes to support a diverse partner ecosystem, including resellers, referral partners, GSIs, SIs, MSPs, ISVs, and cloud marketplaces (e.g., AWS, Azure). Build dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure partner performance, pipeline, and influence. Sales Operations Alignment Partner with Sales Ops and RevOps to integrate partner data into core sales systems (Salesforce, PRM, BI tools). Optimize lead-to-cash processes for indirect routes, including partner deal registration, attribution, and compensation. Partner Program & Enablement Support ongoing evolution of Ping’s partner program, tiers, incentives, and benefits. Ensure operational support for onboarding, certification, and enablement workflows. Track partner participation and compliance with program requirements. Technology & Systems Ownership Own or influence tools that support partner lifecycle (e.g., PRM, Salesforce, LMS, partner portals). Work with IT and vendors to enhance partner system capabilities and integrations. Cross-functional Leadership Serve as the key operations point of contact for Partner Sales, Alliances, and Executive Leadership. Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams to support GTM alignment with technology and cloud partners. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Channel/Partner Operations, or similar roles in B2B SaaS environments. Deep understanding of partner ecosystems including VARs, GSIs, ISVs, MSPs, and hyperscalers. Strong experience with partner programs and partner enablement frameworks. Proven ability to manage and improve sales/partner systems and data quality across CRM and PRM platforms. Analytical mindset with experience in forecasting, attribution modeling, and performance analytics. Excellent project management and cross-functional communication skills. Familiarity with Salesforce, PRM tools (e.g., Impartner, Allbound, or similar), and BI/reporting platforms. Prior identity/security SaaS experience is a plus. Compensation: $180,000–$200,000 base + variable bonus In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities. Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes. We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer. What You'll Do: Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it What You'll Bring: 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable This Role is a Great Fit If: You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, USA Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions. Why you'll love this role StockX has redefined the global marketplace for culture — where buyers and sellers transact with confidence on an always-on digital exchange. We are building the next frontier of creator-driven, culturally rich commerce that blends excitement, community, expertise, and transaction in one platform. This initiative is designed to empower sellers and creators to build sustainable businesses while creating moments that drive deep engagement. To support this effort, we are forming a category-led Go-To-Market organization that scales with culture, category dynamics, and community expertise. The Category Manager is a foundational hire tasked with owning the growth and strategic trajectory of a major category. You will serve as the chief operator, strategist, and market voice for your category — identifying opportunity, building pipelines, and driving seller and creator engagement from early stages through scale. This role blends strategic planning, deep customer and market understanding, and hands-on execution, with full ownership of category growth outcomes. You will work closely with Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Operations to define and accelerate the path to liquidity, engagement, and monetization within your category. What You’ll Do Category Strategy & Ownership Define the strategic vision and growth plan for your category on the platform Become a deep expert on the category’s supply landscape, demand drivers, community channels, and competitive dynamics Establish metrics and quarterly goals to measure and drive category performance Supply & Community Acquisition Build a robust pipeline of sellers, creators, influencers, and shops within your category Drive outbound outreach, onboarding, and enablement for high-potential sellers Cultivate long-term relationships with strategic sellers and community leaders Cross-Functional Go-To-Market Execution Partner with our Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller engagement and support Collaborate with Category Marketing Managers to architect high-impact launches, moments, and campaigns Represent category needs and insights to Product and Engineering to improve seller tools, features, and platform performance Category Performance & Analytics Use data to diagnose growth opportunities, identify bottlenecks, and optimize playbooks Track supply, engagement, retention, and revenue trends and adjust strategies in real time Surface actionable insights to Growth leadership and cross-functional stakeholders Culture & Community Leadership Act as the platform’s representative within your category’s ecosystem Engage deeply with community norms, vernacular, and cultural drivers to inform both strategy and execution Champion creator and seller needs internally to ensure authentic, category-led growth About you Experienced GTM / Growth Operator: 5+ years in business development, partnerships, category management, or marketplace growth roles; experience in consumer platforms or two-sided marketplaces preferred Strategic Thinker + Doer: Comfortable defining vision while executing in ambiguous, fast-moving environments Relationship-Driven: Able to build trust quickly with sellers, creators, and internal partners Data Fluent: Makes decisions informed by data and measures what matters Community Minded: Understands cultural nuance, category subcultures, and trends that drive engagement Nice to Have Existing network within the assigned category (e.g., sneaker resellers, influencer communities, boutique shops) Marketplace experience across both supply and demand sides Experience with creator monetization platforms, community-driven commerce, or enthusiast ecosystems Comfort with CRM tools, sales pipelines, analytics dashboards, and seller performance metrics Why This Role Matters As one of the first Category Managers supporting this new commerce initiative, you will: Set the playbook for how categories scale on an emerging platform Shape how StockX engages sellers, creators, and communities at scale Build the foundation of a repeatable, category-centric GTM / Growth engine that expands into new verticals This role is both strategic and entrepreneurial, with meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence the trajectory of a high-potential new product. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary. About StockX StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. items.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph This is a remote position based in Spain. The Opportunity: As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success. As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph , you’ll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best. Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences. You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales. What You’ll Be Doing: Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community What Makes You a Great Fit: 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy Bonus Points For: Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact When you apply, please: Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective. Compensation & Rewards: In Spain, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 75,724 - EUR 90,869. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs’ success. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. items.summary: The OpportunityAs a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant. Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content. Originally posted on Himalayas
